how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the SGGU recruitment page.

Fill in the post applied for, subject, specialisation, advertisement number and date, your personal details (in capital letters), your educational qualifications, your experience and up to 5 research papers in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals. Then sign the declaration.
Fill in a separate form for each post if you are applying for both.
Self-attest all proofs of qualification and experience and attach them to the form.
Attend the open interview on 4 November 2026 at 11:00 am at Shri Govind Guru University, At. Vinzol, Post Kankanpur, Ta. Godhra, Dist. Panchmahal, Pin 388713, at your own expense.
The form's checklist asks for self-attested copies of the following, with the page number of each:
Annexure-C (as per the Gujarat Public Universities Uniform Statutes, 2024)
Caste certificate for SC/ST/SEBC/EWS, if applicable, and a non-creamy layer certificate for SEBC
10th SSC and 12th HSC marksheets and certificates
Bachelor's and Master's degree marksheets and certificates
UGC-NET / JRF / SLET / GSET / equivalent certificates
M.Phil. marksheet and degree certificate, and Ph.D. degree notification and certificate
Other relevant documents, such as research publications and presentations
One government photo ID: Aadhaar card, PAN card, Voter ID or driving licence
Candidates without a photo ID will not be allowed into the interview. Applications that are incomplete or unclear, or that come with incomplete certificates, may be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Both posts are purely temporary and on an 11-month ad hoc contract at the Ph.D. Facilitator Centre. A person appointed under this notice has no right to be absorbed into the university's regular establishment and cannot make any claim for it. Pay is a fixed monthly amount, with no pay scale. If a question comes up later about whether a qualification, university, institution or course is recognised, the university or appointing authority makes the final decision.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the SGGU walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 4 November 2026 (Wednesday) at 11:00 am at Shri Govind Guru University, At. Vinzol, Post Kankanpur, Ta. Godhra, Dist. Panchmahal, Pin 388713.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for the Research Advisor-Facilitator post?
faq.answer: Rs. 40,000 per month, fixed, for an 11-month contract.

faq.question: Q3. How much does the Statistical Analyst post pay?
faq.answer: Rs. 25,000 per month, fixed.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification do I need for Statistical Analyst?
faq.answer: A postgraduate degree with 55% marks in Statistics, Mathematics or another related discipline, plus 2 years of experience in data analysis, report analysis, coordination and drawing findings.

faq.question: Q5. How much experience does the Research Advisor-Facilitator post require?
faq.answer: 3 years at a higher education institution in the relevant discipline, covering research methodology, research papers, data collection and data analysis.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: Yes, but you must submit a separate application for each post.

faq.question: Q7. What time should I reach the venue?
faq.answer: Arrive 30 minutes before the interview starts for document verification, and bring an Aadhaar card, PAN card, Voter ID or driving licence as photo ID.

faq.question: Q8. Which languages must candidates know?
faq.answer: Adequate Gujarati and Hindi and a general knowledge of English, for both posts.

faq.question: Q9. Will this contract job lead to a permanent post?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the posts are purely temporary and on contract, and the person appointed has no right to be absorbed into the university's regular establishment.

faq.question: Q10. How many research papers can I list in the application form?
faq.answer: The form has space for 5 research papers in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals, with the journal name, ISSN number and journal type for each.
